in_hebrew.name: ברטרנדו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Bertrando is derived from the Germanic elements beraht (bright, famous) and hand (man, warrior). In Hebrew, the name can be transliterated as ברטרנדו (Bertrando). It carries the meaning 'Strong, Brave, and Ready'. This name is not found in the Bible.

in_greek.name: Βερτρανδος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Bertrando is derived from the Germanic elements beraht (bright, famous) and hand (man, warrior). In Greek, the name is transliterated as Βερτρανδος (Bertandros). It carries the same meaning 'Strong, Brave, and Ready'. This name is not found in the Bible.
